run_file_splitter: run the FileSplitter to split a large file into smaller files with a set number of lines
split_large_file: split a large text file into multiple smaller files each containing a specified number of rows
parse_args_file_splitter: parse command line arguments to configure the input file name and split size for file splitting
get_new_file: get a new file object ready to write to with an incremented file number and original extension
usage_file_splitter: display the usage instructions for the file splitter CLI tool with file name and optional row count
